text: Mostly because it gives them a sense of purpose that a salary alone can't. Some volunteer out of a genuine wish to help, while others see it as a way of gaining experience or meeting like-minded people, and there's nothing wrong with that. Interestingly, studies suggest helping others tends to boost one's own happiness, which may be a hidden motive for many of us.

text: They've become more individual-centred. Extended families used to live under one roof, whereas nowadays relatives are often scattered across cities or even countries, so contact depends heavily on technology. On the plus side, younger people have greater freedom to choose their own path. The flip side is that grandparents can feel isolated, which is a loss for everyone involved.
